a:

according to oxford dictionaries it is XXXXX:

[n] 1 : a small intestine: :
  (in anatomy) a small glandular part of some parts of the gut, usually a part of a duodenum. (in medicine) a small piece of intestine removed during surgery
  2 : the small intestine: a body tract usually surrounded by the small bowels and connected to the large intestines by the pylorus. the intestinal tract usually is not longer than 15 centimeters in length
  3 : a small intestinal section : the small intestine of a person who has been dead for 15 to 20 days and is removed after this period, so that the section does not contain cancerous or other abnormal
